entries.t: 30%+效率！曜能科技全球首片G12H p-HJT钙钛矿叠层电池喜获认证，正式探索太空光伏领域
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能源测/发电技术/光伏
entries.as: 曜能科技自主研发的G12H钙钛矿/p-HJT叠层电池通过中国计量科学研究院认证，全尺寸光电转换效率达30.53%。该电池利用两端叠层结构实现全光谱高效分段利用，效率对标航天级三结砷化镓。通过减薄工艺，电池具备可弯折和高比功率特性，满足航天器轻质柔性需求。该产品兼容现有系统设计，兼具高性能与低量产成本，正式迈出探索太空光伏领域第一步。
kp: 光电转化效率[G12H p-HJT钙钛矿叠层电池]: 30.53%
[尺寸规格[G12H p-HJT钙钛矿叠层电池]: 210mm*105mm
[叠层结构[p-HJT叠层电池]: 两端(2-Terminal)叠层结构
[核心优势[p-HJT电池]: 具备较高辐射耐受性和极低成本，适配现有perc及下一代系统设计
[物理特性[p-HJT叠层电池]: 通过减薄工艺具备可弯折特性及高比功率
entries.b:
近日，曜能科技（Auner）自主研发的 G12H (210mm*105mm) 钙钛矿/p型异质结（p-HJT）叠层电池正式通过中国计量科学研究院（NIM）认证，全尺寸光电转化效率达到30.53%。该成果是曜能科技在n型叠层电池核心工艺路线上的持续进化，也是向太空光伏方向布局的第一步。依托于自建产线上底电池及叠层顶电池的全流程开发能力，曜能科技率先完成了全球第一个p-HJT叠层电池的标准量产尺寸产品认证。
在商业航天太空探索的时代背景下，太空能源方案是实现此愿景的关键卡点。在复杂的太空环境中，具备较高辐射耐受性和极低成本优势的p-HJT电池已被行业广泛认可为下一阶段实现太空光伏大规模应用的最佳技术选择。而p-HJT叠层是通过两端（2-Terminal）叠层结构对底电池的进一步迭代，通过全光谱的高效分段利用，使电池效率对标航天级三结砷化镓30%效率的标准。该叠层技术在实现效率跃迁的同时，能够直接适配现有perc及下一代p-HJT电池的系统设计方案。同时曜能团队通过减薄工艺使叠层电池具备可弯折的特性，在进一步提升比功率（Power-to-Weight）的基础上，能够兼容航天器对于电源系统轻质、柔性的需求。这种兼顾高性能、低量产成本与系统兼容性的特性，使得钙钛矿/p-HJT叠层电池有望应用到低轨卫星系统，乃至宇宙空间站以及未来的太空算力中心，成为太空光伏领域成本与性能最平衡的“终极技术路线”。
曜能科技自成立之初就一直致力于通过叠层技术创新，跨越式降低光伏发电的成本，希望此次针对太空光伏的技术探索能够加速太空能源供给从“高价定制”转向“普惠高效”的转型趋势，结构性降低太空基础设施的能源成本，为人类探索深空及构建地外文明资产提供可靠、高效的绿色能源引擎。

entries.t: 麻省理工学院蒋业明提出一种低温近零废料的锂辉石转化工艺
entries.c: 零碳产业/物质循环/资源处理/开采技术
entries.as: MIT蒋业明团队开发基于水溶液氟化铵（NH₄F）的低温闭环工艺，可在低于100°C条件下直接处理α-锂辉石精矿，实现锂、铝、硅的完全资源化，无需传统1000°C以上高温焙烧和浓酸浸出。工艺通过化学循环再生试剂接近零废物排放，大幅降低能耗和环境影响，为硬岩锂提炼的高成本高能耗问题提供革新方案。
entries.cm: (A) 传统硬岩精炼工艺采用高温焙烧 + 酸浸路线：需要将 α-锂辉石在 800–1100°C 高温焙烧转变为 β-相；再用浓硫酸在 200–300°C 浸出；产生稀释的硫酸锂溶液，同时生成大量铝硅酸盐固体废渣；后续需额外试剂中和，产生 Na₂SO₄ 或 CaSO₄ 等化学废物。特点：能耗高、排放高、废物多、成本高。(B) 本文提出的新型 NH₄F 水相工艺在 <100°C 的温和条件下，直接用水相氟化铵（NH₄HF₂） 处理 α-锂辉石；无需高温焙烧；同时溶解 Li、Al、Si，并将它们全部转化为高价值产品（锂盐、氧化铝、无定形二氧化硅）；形成闭环化学循环，NH₄F 试剂可再生并循环使用，几乎实现近零废物。当前，锂离子电池需求激增，预计2030年全球碳酸锂当量需求将从2023年的约100万吨增至300万吨。传统锂提取主要依赖南美盐湖卤水，但面临水资源和生态压力；而占全球锂产量一半以上的硬岩矿（如锂辉石）提炼则存在能耗高、废物多、成本高等问题。传统工艺需将α-锂辉石在1000℃以上高温焙烧后用硫酸浸出，不仅能耗巨大，还产生大量固废和化学废物，导致提炼成本是卤水的2-3倍。在低于100℃条件下，直接处理α-锂辉石，实现锂、铝、硅的完全资源化，无需传统高温焙烧和浓酸浸出。生产成本约为5160美元/吨碳酸锂当量，比传统硫酸焙烧工艺降低超过40%实验室规模验证主要基于高品位精矿（6.8% Li₂O），商业低品位原料中杂质（如Mg、Ca）可能增加试剂消耗和纯化复杂性；传统法核心步骤总时间通常1–4小时左右，而本文NH₄F工艺单批反应时间长，完整流程需要98小时，耗时主要来自温和条件下的固体溶解动力学。
entries.b:
当前，锂离子电池需求激增，预计2030年全球碳酸锂当量需求将从2023年的约100万吨增至300万吨。传统锂提取主要依赖南美盐湖卤水，但面临水资源和生态压力；而占全球锂产量一半以上的硬岩矿（如锂辉石）提炼则存在能耗高、废物多、成本高等问题。传统工艺需将α-锂辉石在1000℃以上高温焙烧后用硫酸浸出，不仅能耗巨大，还产生大量固废和化学废物，导致提炼成本是卤水的2-3倍。
麻省理工学院蒋业明教授团队开发出一种基于水溶液氟化铵（NH₄F）的低温闭环工艺，可在低于100℃的温和条件下，直接处理α-锂辉石精矿，实现锂、铝、硅的完全资源化，无需传统高温焙烧和浓酸浸出。该工艺通过化学循环再生试剂，接近零废物排放，显著降低了能耗和环境影响。
工艺核心在于利用水溶液NH₄F体系溶解锂辉石的铝硅酸盐结构。首先，加热NH₄F溶液生成NH₄HF₂和NH₃气体，随后与α-锂辉石在60-80℃反应，生成(NH₄)₃AlF₆固体、(NH₄)₂SiF₆和LiF溶液。通过调节pH值，依次分离出(NH₄)₃AlF₆和无定形SiO₂，再经蒸发浓缩和氨化沉淀得到LiF。LiF可进一步通过硝酸介导的脱氟路径转化为电池级Li₂CO₃或LiOH，而(NH₄)₃AlF₆经高温水解生成冶金级Al₂O₃，同时释放的HF和NH₃立即重新结合为NH₄F，实现试剂闭环再生。
实验使用澳大利亚工业级锂辉石精矿（6.8% Li₂O），锂提取率达100%，SiO₂和Al₂O₃收率分别接近100%和97%。所得Li₂CO₃纯度达99%以上，符合电池级标准；Al₂O₃纯度98.6%，可作为冶炼级氧化铝；无定形SiO₂表现出极高的火山灰活性，水泥砂浆抗压强度远超行业标准，可作为高性能混凝土的辅助胶凝材料。
技术经济分析显示，该工艺生产成本约为5160美元/吨碳酸锂当量，比传统硫酸焙烧工艺降低超过40%，可与高品位卤水生产成本相当。若充分考虑Al₂O₃和SiO₂副产品销售价值，净成本可进一步降至3900美元/吨，实现比卤水更低的生产成本。同时，该工艺能耗较传统方法大幅降低57 GJ/吨LCE，且避免了氢氟酸气体释放和大量尾矿产生。文章于2026年5月28日发表在Science。

entries.t: 比亚迪发布国内首款4nm海量算力智能驾驶芯片
entries.c: AI与智能科技/AI硬件层/芯片
entries.as: 比亚迪发布了国内首款自主研发的 4nm 智能驾驶辅助芯片“璇玑 A3”。该芯片专为支持 L3 和 L4 级自动驾驶设计，结合其自研算法和架构，使算力利用率翻倍。由三枚芯片组合的系统总算力超过 2100 TOPS，代表了目前中国最高水平的智能驾驶芯片算力。
kp: 制程工艺[比亚迪自研智驾芯片“璇玑A3”]: 4nm
技术地位[国内自研辅助驾驶芯片]: 国内首款
智驾能力支持[比亚迪4nm芯片]: 支持L3和L4自动驾驶
entries.b:
Peter Johnson
| May 28 2026 - 7:24 am PT
new in-house 4nm smart driving chip, China’s first, unlocks “the highest level of vehicle intelligence” with L3 and L4 autonomous driving capabilities.
During its Intelligent Strategy Launch on Thursday, BYD unveiled its latest breakthrough technology, “Xuanji A3,” China’s first self-developed 4nm assisted-driving chip.
CEO Wang Chuanfu said during the event that the new chip supports Level 3 and Level 4 autonomous driving, claiming it “represents the highest level of intelligent driving chips in China.”
Combined with its in-house algorithms used in its God’s Eye ADAS system and Xuanji architecture, BYD said computing power utilization has doubled, up 100%.
Powered by three chips, the combined computing power exceeds a whopping 2,100 TOPS. According to BYD, the new Xuanji A3 smart driving chip has already entered mass production.
The bigger news, however, is that unlike most automakers that outsource chips, BYD builds the chips entirely in-house, along with nearly every other vehicle component.
Chuanfu said that BYD is now the only automaker in the world with full control over its assisted-driving supply chain, enabling it to cut costs and continue advancing the new tech.
Since establishing its first dedicated department for computer chips in 2002, BYD has introduced over 2,000 chips and owns five semiconductor manufacturing (wafer fab) facilities. The company has invested over 100 billion yuan ($14.7 billion) into semiconductors with a current team of over 7,000 dedicated to chip R&D.
The breakthrough assisted-driving chip comes after BYD launched its
Blade Battery 2.0 and Flash Charging system
during a disruptive tech event in March, enabling a CLTC range of over 1,000 km (621 miles) and fast charging in as little as five minutes.
BYD is betting not just on new technology like autonomous driving to fuel its rapid growth, but also on developing it in-house, giving the company full control over its supply chain.
While most automakers still rely heavily on outside suppliers, BYD is establishing a near-complete vertical supply chain, allowing it to roll out new tech and vehicles faster while keeping costs down.

entries.t: 科学家利用量子纠缠创建完美的随机数
entries.c: AI与智能科技/其它智能科技/量子信息
entries.as: 苏黎世联邦理工学院的研究人员利用量子纠缠技术，首次生成了经认证的“完美”随机数。该系统由两块超导量子芯片组成，通过一根30米长的冷却管连接。这一量子物理突破有望加强现有的加密系统和数字安全工具。

Science
Scientists create perfectly random numbers using entangled quantum chips for first time
ETH Zurich researchers used entangled quantum chips to generate certified perfect randomness.
By
Neetika Walter
Science
May 27, 2026 02:01 PM EST
By
Neetika Walter
May 27, 2026 02:01 PM EST
Two quantum chips linked through a 30-meter cooled tube enabled scientists to create certified perfectly random numbers.
ETH Zurich
Researchers at ETH Zurich have developed a method to generate what they describe as “perfect” random numbers using quantum physics, a breakthrough that could strengthen encryption systems and digital security tools.
The team created the system using two superconducting quantum chips connected by a 30-meter-long cooled tube. The setup allowed the researchers to generate certified random numbers by exploiting quantum entanglement, where measurements on one quantum bit influence another instantly across distance.
Random numbers are critical for technologies such as encryption, digital identities, lotteries, blockchain systems, and secure communications. However, even modern random number generators can contain tiny biases, where some numbers appear slightly more often than others.
For most applications, those imperfections are negligible. But in cryptography, even the smallest deviation can create vulnerabilities that attackers may exploit.
Chasing perfect randomness
“It may seem strange, but it is almost impossible to create a perfect coin or a perfect die”, said Renato Renner, professor in the Department of Physics at ETH Zurich.
“No matter how symmetric and smooth a die is made, after a roll one of its six faces will always point upwards slightly more often.”
The researchers said even quantum random number generators based on photons and beam splitters are not fully free from systematic errors or bias. To address this, the ETH Zurich team developed a process called “randomness amplification,” which transforms imperfect randomness into certified perfect randomness.
The experiment relied on a Bell test, a well-known method in quantum physics used to verify entanglement between particles. Researchers used two qubits cooled close to absolute zero and linked through microwave photons traveling between the chips.
“This was made possible by an improved so-called Bell-Test with simultaneously high quality and high data rate”, said Andreas Wallraff, another lead researcher on the project.
The 30-meter separation between the qubits played a critical role. According to the researchers, the distance ensured that no information could travel between the
chips
during measurements, even at the speed of light, preventing interference with the randomness.
Quantum chips seal deal
The team intentionally selected measurement settings using an imperfect random number generator. They then applied a specialized algorithm to amplify the randomness of the resulting measurements.
“The resulting sequence of zeros and ones is now really perfectly random, and we can even certify that”, said Renner.
He compared the achievement to crossing a major technological threshold. “The technical improvements allowed us, for the first time, to create random numbers that will remain perfectly random for all eternity – no matter what analytical methods are used to assess their randomness.”
Researchers believe the technology could eventually serve as a trusted source of randomness for secure digital systems, much like
atomic clocks
provide certified timekeeping standards today.
The work may also support future quantum-secure communication networks, where strong encryption depends heavily on high-quality random numbers.
The study was published in the journal
Nature
.

entries.t: 我国42自由度仿人机器人XMAN-L1亮相
entries.c: AI与智能科技/具身智能/硬件和控制
entries.as: 擎朗智能正式发布XMAN-L1仿人机器人，专为交互式服务应用设计。该机器人高136厘米，采用轻量化结构，具备先进移动能力和AI驱动的通信功能。产品主要面向客户互动、引导及轻娱乐场景，突显了服务型人形机器人在现实服务款待行业中的应用趋势。
entries.b:
KEENON Robotics has officially unveiled the XMAN-L1, a compact humanoid robot designed for interactive service applications.
Standing 4.4 feet (136 cm) tall, the robot combines lightweight construction with advanced mobility and AI-powered communication capabilities.
The company says the humanoid is aimed at customer engagement, guidance, and light entertainment scenarios as part of its broader robotics lineup.
The launch highlights the growing push toward practical humanoid robots for real-world service and hospitality environments.
Recently, the Shanghai-based firm
the KEENOW K1 robotic mower, eliminating perimeter wires and RTK stations to deliver instant, hassle-free lawn mowing for homeowners.
XMAN-L1 is a compact humanoid
developed for interactive commercial and service applications. Standing 136 cm tall, the robot combines lightweight construction with advanced motion capabilities, making it suitable for environments that require close human interaction and flexible deployment, reports
The XMAN-L1 is equipped with 42 biomimetic degrees of freedom, enabling it to perform fluid, natural movements. Its peak knee joint torque reaches 132 Nm, while each leg delivers more than 2,000 W of power to support stable and dynamic mobility. The robot also features edge-side computing performance of up to 100 TOPS, enabling real-time processing and responsive operation in complex environments.
To enhance communication and user interaction, the humanoid integrates large language models from Doubao and Tencent, enabling natural-language dialogue and intelligent conversational capabilities. Keenon positions the robot within its “general-purpose + specialized” product ecosystem, where it serves as a lightweight interactive platform for customer engagement and service tasks.
According to sources, the XMAN-L1 is designed for applications such as visitor reception, guidance services, interactive entertainment, and public-facing activities. The robot is commercially ready and available for immediate deployment following its official release.
KEENON offers a broad portfolio of services and intelligent robots designed for hospitality, healthcare, retail, industrial, and commercial environments. The company is widely known for its autonomous delivery robots, which are used in restaurants, hotels, hospitals, and office buildings to transport food, medical supplies, and other items efficiently.
Its delivery robot lineup includes the DINERBOT series for restaurant food service, the BUTLERBOT series for hotel room delivery, and the T series robots developed for industrial logistics and factory material handling. These robots are equipped with autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, and multi-floor delivery capabilities through elevator integration.
KEENON also develops cleaning robots under the KLEENBOT range. These machines handle sweeping, scrubbing, vacuuming, and dust control in malls, airports, offices, and public facilities. The company’s robotic solutions are designed to reduce repetitive labor while improving operational efficiency.
Keenon also develops a range of service-focused humanoid platforms under its XMAN series, including the
and XMAN-F1, to which the XMAN-L1 is the latest addition.
XMAN-R1 is positioned as a flexible research and interaction-oriented humanoid designed for adaptive mobility, perception, and human-robot collaboration in varied environments. XMAN-F1 focuses on service and commercial deployment tasks such as reception, guidance, and routine operational assistance in public and enterprise spaces.

entries.t: 首尔大学Jungwon Park通过原子数可控的铂团簇实现强锚定高催化活性并提高制氢性能
entries.as: 首尔大学Jungwon Park团队通过甲醇还原法在氧化铝表面制备强锚定铂簇催化剂，实现对簇中原子数的精确调控（负载量不同原子数差异可达三倍）。铂原子选择性迁移至氧化铝五配位Al³⁺强相互作用位点，1nm尺度兼具高活性和高稳定性，可放大至20克级合成，为氢能载体脱氢反应提供了贵金属高效利用方案。
entries.cm:
在传统负载型金属催化剂中，纳米颗粒虽稳定性较好，但大量内部原子无法参与表面反应，导致贵金属利用率低；而单原子催化剂虽活性高，却易在反应条件下团聚失活。本文通过团簇与Al₂O₃载体形成更强相互作用以降低失活速率，同时通过原子数的精确调控来平衡耐久性和活性
显著提升贵金属利用效率.没有显著降低反应温度，主要在300°C进行，没有显著提高体积、质量储氢密度
entries.b:
在传统负载型金属催化剂中，纳米颗粒虽稳定性较好，但大量内部原子无法参与表面反应，导致贵金属利用率低；而单原子催化剂虽活性高，却易在反应条件下团聚失活。如何在1nm尺度实现既高活性又高稳定性的催化剂，一直是催化领域的重要挑战。
首尔大学Jungwon Park等人通过创新方法制备出强锚定于氧化铝载体的铂簇，实现了对簇中原子数的精确调控，揭示了原子数对簇-载体相互作用、催化活性和稳定性的关键影响，为氢能载体脱氢反应提供了解决方案。
研究团队采用甲醇还原PtCl₄²⁻前驱体，在氧化铝表面原位生成无配体铂原子，并通过空气煅烧和氢气还原，使铂原子选择性迁移至氧化铝边缘强相互作用位点（主要是(100)面Al³⁺五配位位点），形成均匀的铂簇催化剂。该方法可放大至20克级一锅合成，有效避免了传统方法中配体残留导致的颗粒尺寸不均问题。
通过球差校正扫描透射电子显微镜和原子级表征，团队发现这些看似直径均为1纳米的铂簇，实际原子数差异显著。在0.1 wt%、0.25 wt%和0.5 wt% Pt负载量下，最常见原子数分别为约13、25和31，差异可达三倍。尽管平面尺寸相似，但原子数少的簇更接近双层结构，原子数多的则趋向三层结构。这种结构差异直接影响簇与载体的相互作用强度：X射线吸收谱（XAFS）显示，原子数越多，Pt-Al五配位相互作用越强，电子态更接近金属态，但仍保持无定形非晶结构。
在甲基环己烷（MCH）脱氢制氢反应中，这些铂簇展现出优异性能。相比传统纳米颗粒催化剂，簇催化剂氢气产率显著提升，其中0.1 wt% Pt样品初始比活性最高，得益于更高的表面原子暴露比例和结构柔性；0.5 wt% Pt样品则表现出最佳耐久性和选择性（>99.9%），因强载体相互作用抑制了甲苯强吸附导致的积碳。原位DRIFTS和Raman光谱证实，簇催化剂上形成的积碳更软、更无序，不会快速堵塞活性位点。
DFT计算进一步验证了实验发现：MCH在Pt₁₃簇上的结合能更强，有利于活化，而Pt₃₁簇对甲苯的吸附较弱，有利于产物脱附和抗积碳。该催化剂在300°C下氢气产率达3000–12000 mmol H₂/gPt/min，远超此前报道的最高值；在340°C、较高空速下仍能维持高转化率，展现出显著的贵金属利用效率优势。
研究强调，簇催化剂的性能不仅取决于尺寸，更关键在于原子数的精细调控及由此带来的簇-载体界面相互作用。这一发现为设计新一代亚纳米催化剂提供了重要指导，有望推动氢能存储与运输领域的实际应用。文章于2026年5月28日发表在Science。

entries.t: 广东电价暴涨到1元/度后，这3类企业还来得及锁定电价吗？月度合同、余电锁价、配储能，操作方案全说清楚
entries.c: 通用技术/通信和运输/电网技术/配电和电力交易
entries.as: 受现货市场实时出清新规及全球LNG价格飙升影响，广东4月实时电价一度逼近1元/度。针对电价上涨，不同用电主体的境况差异显著：签订年度长协的企业受益；纯现货结算工厂电费激增30%~40%；光伏业主自发自用收益翻倍。报告为用电企业提供了月度合同、余电锁价及配置储能等操作方案，以应对电价结构变化并锁定用电成本。
kp: 日前现货均价[广东4月电价]: 最高678元/MWh(0.678元/度)
实时均价[广东4月电价]: 触及978元/MWh(0.978元/度)
日前均价涨幅[广东4月较3月]: 38%
[电价结算机制[2026年3月新规]: 直接入市用户电价跟随现货市场15分钟实时出清
装机占比[广东燃气机组]: 21.9% (57GW)
entries.b:
广东4月电价的数字让很多工厂老板看愣了：日前现货均价最高678元/MWh(0.678元/度)，实时均价一度触及978元/MWh(0.978元/度)，多次逼近1元/度关口。4月1日至23日，广东现货日前均价达533元/MWh，较3月上涨38%。
这不是短期异动，而是两件事叠加的结果：一是2026年3月1日新规落地，直接入市用户的电价由政府定价改为跟随现货市场15分钟实时出清——电价的「缓冲垫」消失了;二是霍尔木兹海峡航运近乎停滞，全球LNG价格飙升，广东燃气机组(占总装机21.9%，57GW)成为高峰时段的边际定价机组，燃料成本暴涨直接推高了整个现货市场的出清价。
电价结构已经变了，「等政策调回来」的想法是危险的。东方证券在4月研报中明确判断：「预计广东现货及长协电价将率先走出长期下行周期」。5月月度中长期电价已较4月初继续走高约30%，夏季6~9月用电高峰还没到来。
在这个背景下，3类用电主体的处境差别极大：
年初签了年度长协(均价0.372元/度)的企业，4月实际是受益方——合同价低于现货，这批用户是「运气好的那批人」;而走纯现货结算的工厂，4月电费账单可能直接比去年同期多出30%~40%;光伏业主的自发自用收益悄悄翻倍了(替代电价从0.38元涨到了0.6~0.9元)，但余电上网的价格要不要锁定、储能该不该配，这两个决策现在就是分水岭;代理合同快到期的企业，若不主动续签而被动转目录电价，每度电可能多花0.05~0.15元，月用电100万度的工厂意味着每月额外支出5~15万元。
索比光伏网对这3类用电主体逐一分析了现状、算了具体的钱、给出了月度合同/余电锁价/配储套利三个工具的操作说明，以及按紧迫程度排序的行动路径。
